reviewer: game_ssial_full direct visual self review; independent acceptance pending

face.observation: Double swept silver fins and low eyes preserve EDDQ identity without the SEDDQ center crest.

silhouette.observation: Split blue coat, square collar accents and belt distinguish the full EDDQ silhouette. Entire head, hands and soles fit inside alpha margins.

emblem.observation: Circular metal rim contains a clear horizontal center band and parallel rows of metal roller ends above and below; no radial spokes, flower, PO droplet or GA hexagon.

material.observation: Curved thin segmented coat panels convey nonaging deep formability; no numeric strength claim.

thumbnail72.observation: Actual 72 by 108 raster and graphite-composited 72px contact were directly viewed: face, blue family silhouette and circular horizontal-band badge remain readable; no crop or baked text. Split blue coat, square collar accents and belt distinguish the full EDDQ silhouette.
